correctness.rationale: Every payoff advantage follows from matrix arithmetic with no self-interactions; the absorbing-chain recurrence yields D_A and D_C exactly. The resulting degree-25 polynomial has three sign changes, root at 1 with negative derivative, strictly positive value at 6/5 and negative value at 2. Descartes plus IVT fixes exactly three positive roots, and positive denominators translate their signs into the all-selection A,C,A ordering. The standalone exact rational checker independently solves ten absorbing-chain systems and matches formulas. No infinite claim rests on sampling.

value.rationale: Two different possible evolutionary innovations can exchange which fixes more readily twice as selection strength varies, even in a six-person well-mixed process with all nonnegative payoffs and no update-mechanism change. The witness has complete algebraic root classification over all positive intensities and strict separated inequalities; it is a motivated boundary for extrapolating weak/strong selection rankings and cannot be inferred merely from the classic opposite-direction fixation ratio.
